description: For a demo tday.com may list as out of date: the merged changes on its features since it was made (with each commit, to read in this repo with git show), the docs sections it sits under whose text changed and how they read now, and what the demo says line by line. Use it to decide whether the demo needs a new take before recording one: a typo or wording fix, or a change to a part of the product the demo never visits, does not. Needs no demo running.

projectId.description: The demo (its projectId, as demo_features or the prompt names it)

name: demo_changes
title: See what changed since a demo was made
